function.arguments: {"finding": "The treatment and control arms are imbalanced on baseline severity: the treatment arm has more severe patients (95 severe vs 21 in control), while the control arm has more mild patients (332 vs 58). The observed difference (treatment effect = -0.0869) may be misleading — in fact, it could be the opposite of the true treatment effect if severity independently affects response.
